description: Compare the transcripts of several videos and group reuploads (the same video uploaded again) and clips (an excerpt of a longer video, with the [m:ss] where it starts in the original and the range it covers). Use it before writing a brief across many videos: count each group once (representativeOf maps every video to its original), or a clip agreeing with its own source looks like consensus. Related pairs share passages without being copies. Works on transcripts only; re-dubbed or translated reuploads are not detected.

urls.description: Video URLs or ids; playlists and channels are expanded
